items.description: NULLWAKENullWake is a psychological horror game about isolation, uncertainty, and the slow collapse of reality.You wake up in an abandoned hospital.The building feels familiar, almost safe — until small details begin to feel wrong.Lights flicker. Corridors stretch longer than they should.The world does not break all at once. It erodes.As you move forward, the environment changes around you.A deserted town. Empty streets. Mannequins standing where no one should be.Locations blend together, as if different worlds are overlapping.NullWake does not explain everything.It lets you notice what should not exist.Fear here is not constant — it waits.ATMOSPHERE OVER ACTIONThe horror in NullWake is built on tension, silence, and expectation.There are moments where nothing happens.Those moments are intentional.Enemies do not follow predictable rules.Sometimes the safest option is to stop moving.Sometimes stopping is the worst choice you can make.A FRAGMENTED STORYThe story is told through environments, visual clues, and subtle changes in the world.Not everything you see can be trusted.Reality shifts slowly, and the game never tells you exactly when it happens.FEATURESPsychological horror focused on atmosphere and tensionMultiple interconnected locationsUnpredictable enemy behaviorEnvironmental storytellingA slow, oppressive pacing inspired by classic horror experiencesNullWake is not loud.It does not rush you.It waits for you to realize that something is wrong.And by then, it is already too late. items.description: Imagine that you suddenly woke up in a very strange and terrible place. You do not remember how you get here. The only important thing is that you have to get out of here as soon as possible. Location in which you currently in is similar to the old subway tunnels with outbuildings. This place is full of danger, scary objects and evil monsters. But it also contains tips that will help you break free.Under The Ground is not a horror, it is a room escape game with horror elements. Game contains many different puzzles and logical tasks that need to be solved in order to find a way out. The game has a horror atmosphere with beautiful graphics and amazing sound effects.The gameplay in Under The Ground is to look for and produce the necessary items and apply the tips to solve puzzles. If you solve all the tasks, you can get to the surface. To make the game more complicated, you can disable the notes button in the settings menu. Try to escape!
